name: BAE-Adaptive (Ramôa & Santos 2025)
affiliation: INL / INESC TEC / University of Minho
description: Bayesian Amplitude Estimation baseline after Ramôa & Santos (Quantum 9, 1856 (2025), arXiv:2412.04394): credible-interval variant with adaptive circuit depth selection inversely proportional to posterior angle standard deviation (2k+1 ~ c / sigma_theta). The paper's sequential-Monte-Carlo posterior and expected-variance look-ahead design are not reproduced.
